name: Alexis of Rozenkreuz
source:
The ancient house of Rozenkreuz is known as a family of powerful alchemists due to their unique affinity with all six elements of magic.
Proud of their lineage and levelheaded beyond their years, Alexis nevertheless possesses a lively curiosity of their surroundings and the people around them.
Which is just as well - for it will be needed.
